sentences.text: After hearing the counsel for the petitioner in length and also going through Exhibit P16, I am of the considered opinion that the 1st respondent has to take a decision in the light of Exhibit P16 proceedings of the Land Revenue Commissioner, within one month and produce the order before this court.

While deciding the matter the 1st respondent will also consider the dictum laid down by the High Court of Punjab & Haryana in Civil Writ Petition No. 9653 of 1994, which is confirmed by the Apex Court in Civil Appeal No.2149/2010.
The petitioner will make available a copy of these orders before the 1st respondent.
Hand over a copy of this order to the Government Pleader, who will communicate the same of the officer concerned.
Exhibit P1 A COPY OF THE PARTITION DEED DTD.9.11.1926
. Exhibit P2 A COPY OF THE SETTLEMENT DEED DTD.6.4.1992

. Exhibit P16 A TRUE COPY OF THE REPORT DATED 16/11/2023 SUBMITTED BY THE LAND REVENUE COMMISSIONER BEFORE THE GOVERNMENT Jasmine vs State Of Kerala on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/20068286/
